VERDICT: REJECT

The proposed answer of 4 is likely wrong. I recall a result on this exact quantity, a(3,n), which gives the value 3 for n ≥ 18, and the Walther-graph construction on 18 vertices is known to have exactly 3 longest paths, not 4. The proposed solution's claim that every such graph has 4 longest paths sharing a common vertex is also unsupported, and it does not match what I recall of the literature. I did not verify this by computation or by checking the source paper, so my confidence is moderate.

CONFIDENCE: 3
